name: lock-race-acceptance
body: The project's observable acceptance criteria. (1) A parallel burst of node/edge mutations completes with zero lock errors — whether by waiting, by not opening the DB at all, or via a session. (2) An unflushed or crashed session loses nothing durable. (3) The next `apg scan` rebuilds `db.lbug` and the mutation is visible. (4) The `apg node` / `apg edge` command surface and every agent prompt that calls it are unchanged (transparency). (5) One logical mutation still produces one commit. These are the conditions the reviewer checks; satisfaction is by review, not asserted by the binary.
